title: Dialog 심화 문제

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 쓰라는 칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 쓰라는 칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④ No, I haven't. B가 그것이 무엇인지 물으므로 들어 본 적이 없다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 심화 01)
questions.promptEn:
Choose the best response.

A: Have you heard about smart chairs?
B: ______. What are they?

questions.sectionInstructionKo: 대화를 나오는 순서대로 누르시오. 말을 순서대로 누르세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ②. Look at this chair! → It's a smart chair. Have you heard about smart chairs? → No, I haven't. What are they? → They are chairs with special sensors. → I'm surprised that a chair can do so many things. (답지 p.38 Dialog 심화 02)
questions.promptEn:
Tap the lines in the order of the dialog.

1. No, I haven't. What are they?
2. Look at this chair! It looks comfortable.
3. They are chairs with special sensors. They can check your health while you are sitting.
4. I'm surprised that a chair can do so many things.
5. It's a smart chair. Have you heard about smart chairs?

orderChunks.text: No, I haven't. What are they?
Look at this chair! It looks comfortable.
They are chairs with special sensors. They can check your health while you are sitting.
I'm surprised that a chair can do so many things.
It's a smart chair. Have you heard about smart chairs?

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 쓰라는 칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 쓰라는 칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ③. 새 영화를 들어 본 적이 전혀 없다고 한 뒤에 어제 봤다고 하면 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 심화 03)
choices:
A: Have you heard about the new library?
B: Yes, I have. I heard it is very big.

A: Did you know about the school festival?
B: Yes, I did. It will be next week.

A: Have you heard about the new movie?
B: I have no idea. I watched it yesterday.

A: Did you hear the news about the soccer match?
B: Yes, I did. I can't believe that we won the game!

A: I went to the supermarket this morning, but it was closed.
B: I'm shocked that the store is closed today.

questions.promptEn:
Read the dialog.

G: Have you heard about 3D printers?
B: Yes, I have. Actually, I have seen smaller ones before, but this one is very big.
G: Yeah. It's because this is used for making buildings.
B: I see. I'm surprised that a 3D printer can build buildings.
G: Me too. ⓐ <u>Let's take a closer look at it.</u>

04 Which sentence means the same as ⓐ <u>Let's take a closer look at it.</u>

It's because the 3D printer ______.

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 쓰라는 칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 쓰라는 칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ③ ⓒ. 안경에 대해 잘 모른다는 흐름이므로 I know much about them → I don't know much about them. (답지 p.39 Dialog 심화 07)
questions.promptEn:
[07-10] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

M: Hi, everyone! Today's special guest is Emma Brown. She has made a lot of amazing items.
W: Hi! <u>ⓐThanks for having me today.</u>
M: Thank you for coming. <u>ⓑPlease tell us about your new item.</u>
W: Sure. I made smart glasses. Have you heard about them?
M: Yes, I have, but <u>ⓒI know much about them.</u> What is special about these glasses?
W: They can show digital information, such as maps, in front of your eyes.
M: Wow! <u>ⓓThen I don't need to use my smartphone for directions anymore.</u>
W: Exactly. Also, they can recognize your voice and send texts.
M: (A) 안경이 그 모든 것을 할 수 있다니 놀랍네요! Can I take a look?
W: Of course. <u>ⓔLet me show you.</u>

07 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름상 어색한 것은?
